test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on a sum of ₹19,500 invested for 1(2)/(5) years at 10% p.a., interest compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 19500

Rate = 10%

Time = 1(2)/(5) years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Interest = A - P

A = amount

P = principal or sum

r = rate

n = time

**Calculation:**

Interest rate for 2/5 years = 10 × (2/5) = 4%

Now,

A = 19500(1 + 10/100)¹ × (1 + 10/100)²/⁵

⇒ A = 19500(1 + 10/100) × (1 + 4/100)

⇒ A = 19500(1 + 1/10) × (1 + 1/25)

⇒ A = 19500(11/10) × (26/25)

⇒ A = 22308

So, interest of the given years = 22308 - 19500

⇒ Rs. 2808

**∴ Required compound interest is Rs. 2808.**
